items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private. Do not send external outreach, expand alerts, deploy, change credentials/configuration, monetize, or claim launch clearance. Evidence: official API access is documented, but permission to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data is not established; current public terms point against the proposed use. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown, including open banner/consent findings on 16 sites and privacy/terms findings on 4. Analytics has 39 configured sites, but source freshness/permissions remain yellow; revenue is one aggregate day with $0 site-attributed commission. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries are preserved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Partial evidence is recorded for official API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields and provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness/correction/takedown, alert identifiers and retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked and counsel_required for public display, derivatives, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed. Operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed. No data-use item is clear or conditional enough to support public launch.

Fleet review: ordinary growth is not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry. Continue only existing bounded, reversible work that preserves disclosures, consent, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards. Do not close compliance or security items from absent sweeps. Private or gated properties require an explicit keep-private decision and completion of their rights, privacy, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner checklist before exposure.
